This is the complete local source project for the approved Planzo web design. It uses the React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 + Tailwind 4 structure from the supplied Figma Make reference.

## Start here

- **Working Make destination:** [Planzo — Working Prototype](https://www.figma.com/make/4tPr5AkQO1g0L1esRvGRjz).
- **Upload instructions and prompt:** [UPLOAD_TO_FIGMA_MAKE.md](UPLOAD_TO_FIGMA_MAKE.md).

The complete editable source was successfully imported into the working Make destination above on 15 October 2026. Figma confirmed source acceptance. Dependency installation, hosted preview and publishing remain unverified. See docs/HANDOFF.md for the receipt and next check.

## Try the demo

1. Open the app and choose **Explore the Goa sample**. It opens Naina's current plan.
2. Check the complete personal estimate, acknowledge the terms, and choose a response.
3. Use the visible **Demo persona** selector to act as different members of the same local group.
4. Use **Scenarios** to create separate examples for changed plans, five of six ready, changed headcount, missing prices, incompatible dates and optional activities.
5. To test actual form entry, create a demo organiser account, create a trip, and copy its invite link. Open that link in another tab of the same browser to join with a name.

A new trip starts with one organiser. Add and confirm at least the selected minimum number of travellers' briefs before publishing. The sample trip contains six confirmed fictional members for faster testing.

## What works

- Organiser signup/signin simulation, group setup and editable date windows.
- Revocable invitation links; name-only guest entry without signup.
- Private brief views, drafts, confirmed input, equal interest stars, editable natural language, sample voice transcript and optional local interpretation.
- Four rule-based sample concepts checked against confirmed availability, whole-trip ceilings and supported requirements.
- Itinerary choices and item-level polls; editable ballots, abstention, closure rules and ties.
- Complete individual cost calculations, room and vehicle sharing, attendee-only optional charges, fees and contingency.
- Versioned ready/change/decline responses. Material changes invalidate old readiness.
- Pending, agreed and postponed outcomes; explicit roster proposals and repricing.
- Provider comparisons in five categories; booking task ownership and versioned self-reported status.
- Safe plan summary copying and shared decision history.
- Browser persistence, reload, failed-save retry demonstration, and responsive layouts.

## Deliberate demo limits

- Data is stored on this browser's origin using localStorage. Session identity and unfinished form fields use sessionStorage.
- Links do **not** synchronise trips across devices, browsers or origins. Real shared trips need Supabase later.
- The persona switcher is a test tool. This is not secure authentication or real access control. Use fictional data.
- Password fields are a visual preview: their values are not saved or verified.
- Voice does not record audio. The interpretation preview uses simple local rules and sends nothing to an AI provider.
- Concepts, times and prices are illustrative. This catalogue covers Goa, Bengaluru-origin travel, three days / two nights, and groups up to six. Other inputs are retained but block complete-price validation where unsupported.
- Food venues and activity options are suggestions, not verified inventory. External buttons open generic provider sites.
- A reported booking is not provider verification or a reservation. Reports from an older plan version remain labelled as earlier reports.
- No Supabase project, live AI, GitHub repository, email service, payment or booking API was modified or connected.

## Run locally

Use Node 22.12+ and pnpm. The supplied .mise.toml retains the reference's Node 22 and pnpm 10 toolchain; local verification used Node 22.14 and pnpm 11.25.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run dev
```

The default preview port is 8443. For a different port, set PORT before running the development command. Figma Make manages its own preview server.

```sh
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build
```

The format command uses the installed TypeScript printer; this avoids a syntax issue in the supplied reference formatter.

The tests use Node's built-in runner and experimental TypeScript stripping in Node 22. This warning does not affect the passing test results. Browser checks in tests/browser.mjs are optional and require Playwright plus Chrome; they are not runtime dependencies.

## Structure

- src/main.tsx and src/App.tsx: entrypoint, navigation, local demo sessions and workspace.
- src/domain.ts: pure trip, cost, feasibility, voting, version and booking rules.
- src/store.ts: browser persistence adapter; a future backend should replace this boundary.
- src/entry.tsx, preferences.tsx, planning.tsx, decisions.tsx, bookings.tsx: user journeys.
- src/ui.tsx and src/index.css: reusable controls and Figma-derived visual tokens.
- public/assets/: exact exported Figma SVG assets, stored locally.
- src/assets/fonts/: locally bundled Inter fonts and their OFL license.
- .figma/make/: reference-compatible development, install, format and deployment hooks.
- tests/: rule tests and optional browser journeys.
- docs/: handoff, design mapping and verification evidence.

# Private inputs and planning — verified checkpoint, 17 October 2026

Package 2 is implemented in existing Make 4tPr5AkQO1g0L1esRvGRjz and only Trip Pact ewysgpuwvufbklesdhuj. The latest human clarification changes the requirement policy: prioritise must-haves, but exclude requests that cannot fit the budget/time/group plan and clearly tell the affected person why. Agreement requires their explicit acceptance of the disclosed result. Never silently omit a must-have or claim unverified feasibility.

## Current behaviour

New trips use workflow 2; earlier workflow-1 trips keep their existing routes and immutable history. A six-question guided conversation collects personal availability inside a tentative date option, travel buffers, whole-trip ceiling and personal travel reserve, interests/places, private must-haves and flexible answers. This guide is structured UI, not an LLM call for each question. Nothing is saved until personal-summary confirmation.

The review now includes editable planning requests, each with a type and hard/soft priority. Suggestions are generated locally; the author must check completeness, wording, type and priority and explicitly approve what may be shared. Raw answers remain private. Surfing and scuba diving from the reported positive list appear as separate hard activity requests. Unrecognised or conditional text stays intact for owner editing; the suggestions are not a general language parser. Long/many requests are rejected for editing, never silently truncated or dropped.

Generation waits for every included person's confirmed input, the minimum roster and at least one common hour after personal outbound/return travel buffers. Gemini Free Tier additionally requires TEST · AI labelling, fictional assertions and separate Allow Gemini consent from everyone. Only owner-reviewed shareable requests/interests/places, destination and common times go to Google. Private cities, ceilings, exact personal times, raw private hard/soft answer text, IDs and credentials are excluded. Reviewed request text is intentionally shared; owners must remove private reasons before approving. Existing consent is not silently expanded: summaries saved before this correction must be reopened and freshly reviewed before a new generation.

Gemini orders the approved requests. The server prioritises hard activities, builds a continuous itinerary with meals/rest/stays, includes personal travel reserves within ceilings and records an outcome for every request. Activity requests are scheduled once; requests that cannot fit are explicitly excluded for budget or timing. Meal/stay requests are attached to relevant steps and marked for booking verification. Other unsupported conditions are excluded from the promised plan as unverified; they are never declared satisfied. A single traveller does not get a group poll. The fictional reference allowances are food INR350/block, stay INR1500/night, surfing INR2500, scuba INR4500, sailing INR2000, other activities/local travel INR550, INR50 fees and 10% contingency. These are test assumptions, not real fares, quotes, instructor safety or destination availability checks.

Group alternatives use most votes after all ballots or the deadline; ties remain unresolved. Concerns need a strict majority of the included roster to change a step. Changed activities recalculate cost and requirement outcomes, including exclusions caused by the group decision, and create a new immutable version with fresh reviews. A step change that exceeds a confirmed budget is rejected. Ballots and private reasons remain private. Every included person reviews the exact current version and explicitly acknowledges their own exclusions. An organiser can lock only after all included reviews. Hard concerns require the affected author's acceptance of the current outcome; a majority cannot manufacture that acceptance. Personal availability and ceilings remain limits. Base meals/stays that exceed a ceiling still block agreement. Locks/history remain immutable; locked plans require reopened input before fresh generation.

## Deployment and verification

Applied once: 20261016173645_planzo_private_inputs_and_planning_flow, then forward correction 20261017115254_planzo_requirement_coverage and 20261017121857_planzo_activity_change_validation. Never edit/reapply these applied migrations. Every canonical migration file equals its corresponding development SQL. The correction adds five private, direct-call-denied helpers and changes four existing flow functions without changing their permissions/search paths. It rewrites no saved input, plan, review, lock or trip row.

planzo-planning Edge version2 is ACTIVE with verify_jwt=true. All five packaged runtime sources read back exactly. Fixed gemini-3.5-flash-lite, one request per admitted attempt, no tools/storage/retries/paid fallback. GEMINI_API_KEY was used without reading its value. Original package: 77 app tests, 48 isolated database checks, 25 initial live UI checks, four signed-out hosted denial probes and Make's 25-file install checks passed. The human later reused the original labelled fixture; do not treat their subsequent actions as agent verification.
